prompt: Pick the right permission triplet from a 9-bit mode: owner bits first, then group, then others. Root skips the check.
explain: Mode 0754 is owner 7, group 5, other 4. The owner triplet is at bits 8 to 6, group at 5 to 3, and other at 2 to 0. Only one class applies: the owner is judged by the owner bits even if the group bits are more generous.
